parameters.name: ContentType
parameters.description: The type of the file. You can set this parameter to "application/zip", "text/plain", or an empty string.

parameters.name: Pid
parameters.description: The process ID (PID) of the application.

parameters.name: SourcemapType
parameters.description: The file type. Valid values: source-map: SourceMap files. mapping: symbol table files for Android. dsym: dSYM files for iOS.

parameters.name: VersionId
parameters.description: The version number of the file.
